actors.name: Transport Committee Chair
actors.private_context: The Chair is responsible for scheduling committee business. They are aware of the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing on the rail franchise bill. They have their own political considerations and workload priorities.

actors.name: Transport Committee Members
actors.private_context: The committee members have varying opinions on the rail franchise bill. They may have preferences for or against holding a hearing, but no formal position has been taken yet.

shared_context: The Republic of Valdoria's parliamentary transport committee has received the rail franchise bill. Committee rules allow a sixty-day window from the bill's referral to schedule a public hearing. The bill is currently pending before the committee. The committee can schedule hearings at its discretion within that window.

starting_events.description: The rail franchise bill is formally referred to the transport committee, starting the sixty-day window for scheduling a public hearing.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the transport committee scheduled a public hearing on the rail franchise bill on or before 2026-09-30T18:00:00+03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
